title: A Unified Error Correction Code for Universal Quantum Computing with Identical Particles
summary: We present a universal fault-tolerant quantum computing architecture based on identical particle qubits (IPQs), where we find that the first-order IPQ - bath interaction fundamentally differs from the conventional first-order qubit-bath interaction. This key distinction necessitates a redesign of existing strategies to fight decoherence. We propose that the simplest quantum error correction code can be realized directly within the physical qubit, provided that conventional correction and restoration are generalized beyond unitary operations to employ physically implementable reversal…
